snapshot.reason: The acquisition of 100% of Shanghai Securities will significantly increase the firm's market share and asset base in the Chinese brokerage sector.
snapshot.why_now: The Shanghai Stock Exchange accepted the application for the asset purchase on August 26, 2026.
